data_description.resolution: Determines how often electricity prices can change. Select the resolution which matches your provider or you may get inaccurate data!
data_description.entities_default_enabled: By default all sensors are disabled to reduce clutter. You can either enable all sensors by default, enable the sensors for specific providers by selecting them below or enable them manually later in the Entities list for the Enever device.

data_description.resolution: Determines how often electricity prices can change. Select the resolution which matches your provider or you may get inaccurate data!

error.token_limit_reached: The monthly token limit has been reached

set_request_limit.name: Set request limit
set_request_limit.description: Sets or increases the API request limit for this month. Note that the request limit will always reset to the default next month.

value.name: New limit
value.description: If specified, sets the request limit for this month to the specified value.

increase.name: Increase current limit
increase.description: If specified and no new fixed value is specified, the request limit for this month is increased by this value.

reset.name: Resets internal data
reset.description: For troubleshooting purposes. Specify which data to reset. Use with care.

request_count.name: Request counter
request_count.description: Set the API request counter for this month to 0.

token_limit_reached.name: Token limit reached flag
token_limit_reached.description: Reset the 'token limit reached' flag which is set when the Enever API reports the token limit has been reached. Useful for when you've upgraded your token limit by becoming a Supporter.
